steps.quote: Site 1 is situated almost in the centre of the Strand, and is the closest inshore. Sand overburden has reached a maximum measured depth of 0.8 m above the highest known part of the wreck and at its lowest point is 1.2 m below the same point, represented by a wrought iron anchor.
